closures.summary: Washington State Parks lists the Little Spokane River Water Trail, the St. George's put-in and Indian Painted Rocks among Riverside State Park areas north of Seven Mile Road that remain closed after the August 2026 wildfires. The 2026-08-28 update is 'the last major reopening update anticipated until spring 2027'.
closures.action: Excluded from catalog/rivers and catalog/map_points. v1 record kept in /workspace/floateta-washington (washington.json). Re-check the State Parks page in spring 2027.

advisories.note: Riverside SP wildfire closures: Plese Flats is not on the 2026-08-28 still-closed list; re-check before trips.
Cashmere Riverside Park ramp reported blocked by flood-deposited rock in spring 2026, with repairs targeted by Apr 30, 2026 (news reports; completion not confirmed).
